name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          # Pinned exactly: Node 24 breaks jsdom tests (built-in localStorage).
          node-version: 22.11.0
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
